wikitext: [[File:A Clefairy Bedtime Story.png|thumb|350px|A Clefairy Bedtime Story]] '''A Clefairy Bedtime Story''' (Japanese: '''おねむりストーリー ピッピ''' ''A {{tt|Pippi|Clefairy}} Sleeping Story'') is a 1-minute {{pkmn|animation|animated}} short based on [[Pokémon Sleep]]. It was released on the official Pokémon [[YouTube]] channels and {{pkmn|social media}} accounts on September 12, 2024. It was accompanied by an in-game event making it easier to encounter {{p|Clefairy}} and also a distibution of a Clefairy {{Sleep|Incense}}. ==Blurb== You’re never too old for a bedtime story, so snuggle up and enjoy a brand-new Pokémon Sleep short, A Clefairy Bedtime Story! Sleep tight, Trainers. 🌝💤 ==Plot== Five {{p|Clefairy}}, one of them {{Shiny}}, are dancing on a forest hilltop. Noticing something, they quickly run off. In a clearing, a {{Sleep|Snorlax}} is eating [[Pecha Berry|Pecha berries]]. The Clefairy continue their dance in front of Snorlax, but the Shiny Clefairy finds it difficult to match the others' rhythm. Due to the [[moon]]'s power, the Clefairy grow fairy wings on their backs and start rising into the sky as Snorlax looks on in amazement. The Clefairy start flying around in the sky, but the Shiny one cannot maintain itself and starts falling. Its fall is broken by Snorlax's squishy belly, and the other Clefairy gather around it to check on it. The Clefairy look at the sky where a meteor shower is visible. As all the Clefairy hug each other, the Shiny one looks happy. Later, the Clefairy fall asleep around Snorlax (as a {{p|Cubone}} looks on), with the Shiny Clefairy practicing {{m|Metronome}}. The scene changes to Clefairy's "[[Sleep style|Metronome Sleep]]" style being recorded in the Sleep Style Dex. ==Characters== ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Snorlax}} ([[Snorlax (Sleep)|Sleep]]) * {{p|Clefairy}} (×4) * {{p|Clefairy}} ({{Shiny}}) * {{p|Cubone}} ==Cast== {{cast/h|Kanto}} {{cast|BDSP|Snorlax (Pokémon)|disp=Snorlax|Katsuyuki Konishi|Kabigon|Katsuyuki Konishi|カビゴン|小西克幸|top=yes}} {{cast|BDSP|Clefairy (Pokémon)|disp=Clefairy|Mayumi Iizuka|Pippi|Mayumi Iizuka|ピッピ|飯塚雅弓|bottom=yes}} |} ==Staff== {| class="credits-table roundtable" style="background: #{{Fairy color light}}; border: 3px solid #{{Normal color dark}}" |- style="vertical-align: middle; background:#fff" ! class="roundytl" width="24%" | Director / Script / Storyboards | class="roundytr" width="38%" | * Yoshimitsu Saito |- style="vertical-align: middle; background:#fff" !
